sources.entry: openai-whisper - A general-purpose automatic speech recognition model trained on 680k hours of multilingual and multitask supervised data.

summary.one_liner: Whisper is OpenAI's general-purpose speech recognition model and Python package, covering multilingual transcription, speech translation, and language identification.
summary.what_it_does: Provides a Transformer sequence-to-sequence speech model in several sizes (tiny through large, plus turbo) with English-only and multilingual variants. It can transcribe audio in many languages, translate non-English speech into English, and detect the spoken language. A command-line tool (`whisper`) and a Python API (`load_model`, `transcribe`, `detect_language`, `decode`) are included. Audio is processed with a sliding 30-second window. The README notes that the turbo model is optimized for transcription but not trained for translation, so the medium or large models are recommended for translation.
use_cases: identify the language spoken in a recording
generate subtitles or transcripts from video or audio
run speech recognition locally in Python
choose a speech model by speed versus accuracy
how_to_run: sudo apt update && sudo apt install ffmpeg
import whisper; model = whisper.load_model("turbo"); result = model.transcribe("audio.mp3")
notable: Single multitask model that replaces several stages of a traditional speech pipeline, including voice activity detection
Six model sizes with English-only (.en) and multilingual variants, with listed VRAM and relative speed
turbo model is an optimized version of large-v3 with faster transcription
Trained on 680k hours of multilingual data according to the awesome-python listing
caveats: Requires the ffmpeg command-line tool installed separately
The turbo model does not perform translation; use medium or large for translation
Performance varies widely by language; speed figures are only approximate and measured on an A100
